CVE-2022-0778 affects the **OpenSSL** library, specifically versions prior to **3.0.6** and **1.1.1t**.

The nature of the vulnerability is a **use-after-free** error in the `SSL_CTX_set_min_proto_version()` function. This flaw allows a remote attacker to potentially cause a denial of service (DoS) by sending a specially crafted TLS handshake message. The vulnerability arises because the function does not properly handle the case where the minimum protocol version is set to a value lower than the maximum allowed, leading to the freeing of memory that is subsequently accessed.

**Source:**
*   **CVE Record:** [CVE-2022-0778](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-0778)
*   **OpenSSL Security Advisory:** [OpenSSL Security Advisory 2022-0778](https://www.openssl.org/news/secadv/20220621.txt) (Published June 21, 2022)
